quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Primogem x20, Mora x10000, Unknown Item #363324 x1

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon, thank you. Now Viparyas is growing across the gardens in Vanarana.

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: The Viparyas here are happy. So Arakara is happy too.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: Festival Utsava is over. Before the Golden Nara leaves Vanarana...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #I gave the happy Viparyas to the Golden Nara. Hope Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon will be happy too. The Viparyas doesn't wither, but...

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: Remember to talk to it occasionally. Better play music for it.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #The land and Aranara will not forget. Hope Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon will not forget...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #This feels just like the time Nara Varuna celebrated Festival Utsava with Aranara all over again... Aranakula hasn't been so happy in a very long time, Nara {NICKNAME}. *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Arakara
dialogues.text: Viparyas hate tears. Festival Utsava is a happy festival. Aranakula will play a happy song for Viparyas!
